messages:
Ellie: Planning to publish the product launch blog on Thu 10:00 PT. Quick triage: who picks up final hero line, benchmark sentence + 2-line methodology note, a clean UI screenshot from staging, top-of-post webinar signup (prefill email if possible), HubSpot hidden fields + UTMs, and a legal quick-pass? Need owners so I can lock the schedule. :calendar:

Samir: I can take the UI screenshot and export hero/social crops. Which URL should I capture?

Ellie: Use app.redwood.dev/demo-flow - grab the token meter + response pane. Please scrub any org names and export 1200x630 + @2x.

Samir: Got it. Will capture and upload to /drive/marketing/launch_screenshots by EOD.

Viv: Ill draft the hero and the benchmark phrasing. Propose two hero variants: A) "Run production LLMs with predictable cost and low latency." B) "Ship LLM features faster with consistent inference economics." Thoughts?

Priya: Ill build the HubSpot form and add hidden fields: `lead_source=prod_blog`, `product_interest=inference`, `orig_utm`, `company_size`. Also wire email prefill via `?email=` and create smart list `PL_LAUNCH_JUN` to collect signups.

OpsBot: Reminder: publish window opens Thu 10:00 PT; staging deploy at 08:30 PT.

Marta (Legal): On the benchmark claim, avoid absolutes. Suggest: "Internal benchmarks indicate up to a 60% reduction in per-token inference cost on representative workloads (see methodology)." Please include a short methodology parenthetical mentioning sample size and baseline hardware.

Viv: Noted Marta. Draft bench line: "Internal benchmarks indicate up to a 60% reduction in per-token inference cost on representative workloads (1k request sample; 8xA100 baseline; end-to-end cost measured)." I'll keep it to two lines and add a footnote anchor.

Ellie: Prefer hero B for the lead rail and hero A for paid ads. Samir - can you ensure CTA length matches hero?

Samir: Yep. Suggest CTAs: short = "Try the demo" / long = "See Redwood Inference in action". Will match image composition accordingly.

Priya: UTMs I plan to use: `?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=prod_launch_jun2026&utm_content={cta_variant}`. For A/B we can set utm_content=left/right. I'll also add hidden field `lead_tier` and doc SFDC routing: company_size>=500 -> Enterprise AE; else SMB SDR. Flag `product_interest=dedicated` for priority.

Marta (Legal): One more nit: avoid "enterprise-grade" unless SLA details are provided. Use "enterprise-ready" or "built for production." Also remove any use of "industry-leading."

Viv: Reworked copy to remove those terms and pushed update to /content/drafts/prod_launch_jun.md with the bench footnote.

Samir: Screenshot uploaded, scrubbed, cropped, exported PNG + webp. Link: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch_screenshots/screen_1738004321.png

Priya: HubSpot form created, hidden fields and email prefill tested, smart list PL_LAUNCH_JUN created, UTMs wired for cta left/right, SFDC mapping documented. Prefill tested end-to-end.

Ellie: Final checklist - react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done: hero locked, bench note added, screenshot uploaded, assets optimized, HubSpot form + hidden fields done, UTMs/AB set, legal sign-off.

Viv: Hero + bench caveat done and pushed. :white_check_mark:

Samir: Screenshot + exports done. :white_check_mark:

Priya: HubSpot + hidden fields + UTMs + smart list done and tested. :white_check_mark:

Marta (Legal): Quick-pass approved given bench phrasing and removal of SLA claims. :white_check_mark:

Ellie: Awesome. Scheduling the post for Thu 10:00 PT and adding the webinar slot (Wed 11am PT) at top of post. Will drop publish notice in #release-war-room once scheduled. :tada:
